title: The Best Smart Speakers
subtitle: Alexa, Google, and Sonos speakers, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: We pulled the best-selling smart speakers on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: a built-in smart home hub, sound quality, and which voice assistant it runs.
systems_note: Echo speakers run Alexa; the Echo Dot Max has a smart home hub built in. Nest speakers run Google Assistant. Sonos Era 100 has Alexa built in.

buyers_guide.a: Pick the assistant that matches your phone and smart home. Echo speakers run Alexa, Nest speakers run Google Assistant, and Sonos speakers can use Alexa or Sonos Voice Control.

buyers_guide.q: Can a smart speaker be my hub?
buyers_guide.a: Some can. Several Echo models have a Zigbee hub or Thread border router built in, and Nest speakers and displays can be Matter controllers. Check the listing if you want it to run your devices too.

buyers_guide.q: How much should I spend for sound?
buyers_guide.a: Small speakers like the Echo Dot are fine for voice and casual music. If music matters, a larger speaker like a Sonos Era is a big step up.
